competency_fulfillment.rationale: Seed 50's rendered question text is '1 cannot be determined 200. True or False?' -- a distractor string appears to have been substituted into the comparison-symbol slot instead of an actual <, >, or = sign, so this item presents no coherent comparison claim for the pupil to evaluate at all.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: None of the 7 rendered seeds, including the new true_false seed 50 and cloze seed 72, ever keys an equals sign; every well-formed comparison item resolves to > or <, so the competency's explicitly named '=' case is never generated.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Most stems are short and clear, but seed 50's '1 cannot be determined 200. True or False?' is not parseable prose and would confuse rather than test a grade 3 reader.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formatter diversity (mcq, true_false, cloze) is present, but content is limited to the fill-in-the-symbol frame throughout, and the true_false format's actual implementation is broken at seed 50 rather than offering a genuine new variant.

competency_alignment.rationale: Even the well-formed items never progress toward 4-digit place-value discrimination this 'up to 10 000' competency should build -- seed 72's 240 vs 208 is still a 3-digit comparison -- and the malformed seed 50 tests no comparison skill at all.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The largest number across all 7 seeds, including the new cloze seed 72's 240, is still under 300; the competency's stated ceiling is 10 000 and no 4-digit number appears anywhere in this widened sample.
